document.title: Stack element; Scroll becomes a scrolling column Stack
document.summary: A native layout pass computes every instance's parent-relative bounds once per instance-tree swap, a new `Stack` element flows its children along a column or row, and `Scroll` reuses the same flow code. Render, hit testing, Focus collection and scroll lookup read the computed bounds instead of walking the old scroll flow.
document.why: Authors position every child by hand today; [issue #47](source:s1) asks for a `Stack` that lays children out, with `Scroll` as a scrolling column Stack so there is one layout path.

sources.title: Stack layout
sources.gist: Approved design: Stack with direction, gap, padding, align, fit-content sizing; child x/y are margin and offset; Scroll becomes a scrolling column Stack; one layout pass per swap.

sources.label: Orchestrator brief · Oct 25
sources.gist: Use Stack in timers or minesweeper, not smoke; the smoke golden must not change; add tests/layout_harness.c.

lookFor: [The proposal](source:s1) has the smoke fixture gain a Stack and refreshes the golden; [the brief](source:s2) overrides that, so smoke is untouched, the golden is unchanged, and `timers` uses Stack instead.
[The proposal](source:s1) makes `x`/`y` optional on Rect, Button and Image; `TextInput` also gets optional `x`/`y`, because it flows in a Stack too.

[The proposal](source:s1) lists Rect, Button, Image, TextInput and Stack as flowed children, so a `Scroll` inside a Stack or Scroll keeps its own `x`/`y` (measured inside the padding), exactly as a nested Scroll behaved before.

groups.title: Layout pass and Stack instance type
groups.why: Enables the consumers: one function computes positions so render, hit testing and Focus agree.
groups.summary: `layout_tree` in `layout.c` fills the new `InstanceLayout` on `ReactInstance` from props, and `NT_STACK` plus a shared `StackProps` (which `NT_SCROLL` now also uses) feed its flow step.
lookFor: Subtle: `layout_flow` reads each child's margin and offset from its layout before overwriting it, the main axis in the first pass and the cross axis in the second, so the order of the two loops matters.
A Stack or Scroll with `width` or `height` 0 fits its content; a Scroll always receives a size from the SDK types, so only a Stack uses this.

groups.title: Render, hit testing, Focus and scroll lookup read the layout
groups.why: The proposal has every reader use the same computed rects; this deletes `scroll_flow_step` and its five walkers.
groups.summary: `instance_tree_swap` runs `layout_tree` on the new snapshot, and every walker in `instance_tree.c` and `render.c` adds `inst->layout` to its parent origin, subtracting a Scroll's offset at use.
lookFor: A Stack hit-tests like a Rect: a point in the gap between two buttons in a Stack returns the Stack's id, not the enclosing Scroll's.
`scroll_at_instance` now descends into Stacks as well as Rects, so drag and wheel find a Scroll nested inside a Stack.

groups.title: Native create and update for Stack
groups.why: The reconciler needs `nativeCreateStack`/`nativeUpdateStack` to build Stack instances.
groups.summary: `create_stack` and `update_stack` serve both Scroll (12 arguments, always a start-aligned column) and Stack (14 arguments, adding direction and align) through one `read_stack_props`.

groups.title: SDK Stack component and reconciler case
groups.why: Authors reach Stack only through `@vitadeck/sdk`; the change is additive.
groups.summary: `Stack` and `VitaStackProps` join the SDK, a shared `Position` type makes `x`/`y` optional, and the reconciler maps `vita-stack` props to native arguments while defaulting every `x`/`y` to 0.

groups.title: Timers example uses Stack
groups.why: [The brief](source:s2) asks for Stack in a non-smoke example.
groups.summary: A column Stack replaces the hand-computed row `y` values, and a row Stack replaces each pair of button `x` values, landing on the same integer positions.

groups.title: Glossary and SDK Layout section
groups.why: AGENTS.md asks for a glossary term for a new user-facing concept and README updates for author-visible behavior.
groups.summary: `CONTEXT.md` gains a **Stack** entry and three Relationships bullets, and the SDK README gains a Layout section with the proposal's example.

groups.title: Layout harness and Stack hit tests
groups.why: Proves the flow math by hand, and that Scroll lands where the old flow put the smoke app's rows.
groups.summary: `layout_harness.c` checks column, row, gap, padding, align, nesting, unflowed Text and Scroll parity against hand-computed positions, `hit_test_harness.c` checks hit, Focus navigation and scroll lookup through a row Stack, and `scroll_math_harness` drops its moved flow tests and links only `scroll.c`.

commits.body:
layout_tree computes every instance's parent-relative bounds once per dirty swap. Render, hit testing, focusable collection and scroll lookup read them, replacing scroll_flow_step and its five walkers. A Scroll shares StackProps and the flow code.
